By the winds sent out one after another.
Blowing hard and strong.
Spreading far and wide.
Separating clearly.
Bringing a message.
To give an excuse or a warning.
What you are promised will surely happen.
When the stars lose their light.
And the sky is split open.
And the mountains are blown away.
And the messengers are brought together.
For which day was it put off?
For the Day of Decision.
What can teach you what the Day of Decision is?
How terrible that Day will be for those who said it was a lie.
Did We not destroy the people long ago?
Then We sent others after them?
This is how We deal with people who do wrong.
How terrible that Day will be for those who said no.
Did We not make you from a weak drop of fluid?
Then We put it in a safe place.
For a known time.
We measured exactly. We are the best at measuring.
How terrible that Day will be for those who said it was a lie.
Did We not make the earth a place to gather?
For the living and the dead.
And put tall mountains on it, and gave you sweet water to drink?
How terrible that Day will be for those who said no.
Go to what you used to say was a lie!
Go to a shadow with three parts.
It gives no shade and does not protect from the flames.
It shoots sparks as big as castles.
Like yellow camels.
How terrible that Day will be for those who said it was a lie.
This is a Day when they will not speak.
And they will not be allowed to give excuses.
How terrible that Day will be for those who said no.
This is the Day of Separation. We have gathered you and the people long ago.
So if you have a plan, use it against Me.
How terrible that Day will be for those who said it was a lie.
The people who feared Allah will be among shade and springs.
And fruits, whatever they want.
Eat and drink and enjoy, for what you used to do.
This is how We pay back people who do good.
How terrible that Day will be for those who said no.
Eat and enjoy a little. You are people who did wrong.
How terrible that Day will be for those who said it was a lie.
And when it is said to them: Bow down, they do not bow down.
How terrible that Day will be for those who said no.
After this, what message will they believe?
